text: Looking into the bug in src/click/core.py related to required flags (test_missing_required_flag). ETA ~15 min.
Got it — bug #2 (echo with no streams, touching src/click/_compat.py, src/click/_termui_impl.py, src/click/utils.py). Working on it in parallel with bug #1. ETA ~15 min.
Noted — bug #3 (tests.test_arguments::test_envvar_flag_value, in src/click/core.py). Investigating now alongside #1 and #2. ETA ~18 min.
Noted — bug #4 (tests.test_arguments::test_when_argument_decorator_is_used_multiple_times_cls_is_preserved, in src/click/decorators.py). Investigating. ETA ~20 min.
Noted — bug #5 (tests.test_types::test_symlink_resolution, in src/click/types.py). Investigating. ETA ~22 min.

Bug #5 fixed: in src/click/types.py, Path.convert resolved symlinks by calling os.readlink() and then os.path.realpath() on the raw (usually relative) link target, which resolved it against the CWD instead of the link's directory. Removed the bogus islink/readlink step; os.path.realpath() alone resolves symlinks correctly. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.
Noted — bug #6 (tests.test_defaults::test_flag_default_map, in src/click/core.py). Investigating. ETA ~10 min.

Bug #1 fixed: Option.__init__ forced default=False for every flag without an explicit default, so a required flag's default was False, value_is_missing(False) was False, and a missing required flag was silently accepted. Now the default is only forced when the flag is not required, so a missing required flag raises "Missing option '--foo'." Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.

Bug #2 fixed: click.echo() crashed with AttributeError when sys.stdout/sys.stderr are None (pythonw on Windows). In _compat.py the text-stream helpers now return None for a None stream (and _make_cached_stream_func handles that), utils.echo() returns early when there is no stream to write to, and _termui_impl.py falls back to StringIO() for ProgressBar/pager. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.

Bug #4 fixed: click.argument()'s inner decorator popped "cls" out of the shared attrs dict, so reusing the same decorator (applied twice, or on two commands) silently dropped the custom Argument class. Now it copies attrs first, matching the existing option() fix. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed — no regressions.
